name: @hasna/releases
description: Release ledger, publish receipts, downstream fan-out, and npm reconciliation CLI + MCP server for Hasna-coded apps

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external bun:sqlite && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external bun:sqlite && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external bun:sqlite && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan:artifact
scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/releases-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan releases-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/releases-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc

author: Hasna
